user.title: Add alarm clock
user.description: Creates a new alarm clock. Alarm time, weekdays and all other settings are configured afterwards through the entities of the alarm clock.

data_description.name: Used as the device name, for example "Alarm 1".

abort.already_configured: An alarm clock with this name already exists.

init.title: Scripts
init.description: All script fields are optional. Leave a field empty to skip that step.

data_description.alarm_script: Runs while the alarm is ringing and is stopped on snooze or dismiss.
data_description.pre_script: Runs the configured number of minutes before the alarm time.
data_description.post_script: Runs after the post offset once the alarm has been dismissed.

snooze.name: Snooze
snooze.description: Snoozes a ringing alarm or extends a running snooze.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Snooze duration in minutes. 0 disables snoozing. Defaults to the configured duration.

dismiss.name: Dismiss
dismiss.description: Stops a ringing alarm or a running snooze and starts the post action.

trigger_alarm.name: Trigger alarm
trigger_alarm.description: Triggers the alarm immediately, for example for testing.

set_alarm.name: Set alarm
set_alarm.description: Sets the alarm time and/or the weekdays.

days.name: Weekdays
days.description: Active weekdays. An empty list means a one-shot alarm.

no_alarm_clocks_target.message: The service call did not target a loaded alarm clock.
